mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName FROM project p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cash_flow cf JOIN settlement_block sb ON sb.settle_id = cf.settle_block_id JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id WHERE st.project_id = p.project_id AND cf.deleted_at IS NULL AND sb.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND cf.company_id = #{companyId} ) ORDER BY p.name ASC
SELECT type AS type, amount AS amount, traded_at AS tradedAt, depositor_name AS depositorName FROM cash_flow WHERE cash_flow_id = #{cashFlowId} AND company_id = #{companyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT settleId, roundName, projectName, plannedAmount, plannedDate, traderName, amountMatchType, dateMatchType, traderMatchType FROM ( SELECT sb.settle_id AS settleId, b.title AS roundName, p.name AS projectName, sb.planned_amount AS plannedAmount, sb.planned_date AS plannedDate, sb.trader_name AS traderName, CASE WHEN sb.planned_amount = #{amount} THEN 'EXACT' WHEN sb.planned_amount BETWEEN #{amount} * 0.95 AND #{amount} * 1.05 THEN 'SIMILAR' ELSE NULL END AS amountMatchType, CASE WHEN sb.planned_date = #{tradedDate} THEN 'EXACT' WHEN ABS(DATEDIFF(sb.planned_date, #{tradedDate})) <= 7 THEN 'SIMILAR' ELSE NULL END AS dateMatchType, CASE WHEN sb.trader_name = #{depositorName} THEN 'EXACT' WHEN sb.trader_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{depositorName}, '%') OR #{depositorName} LIKE CONCAT('%', sb.trader_name, '%') THEN 'SIMILAR' ELSE NULL END AS traderMatchType FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id AND b.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id JOIN project p ON p.project_id = st.project_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE sb.deleted_at IS NULL AND sb.status = 'PENDING' AND sb.type = #{type} AND p.company_id = #{companyId} ) candidates WHERE amountMatchType IS NOT NULL OR dateMatchType IS NOT NULL OR traderMatchType IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (CASE WHEN amountMatchType IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN dateMatchType IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN traderMatchType IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, ABS(DATEDIFF(plannedDate, #{tradedDate})) ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT type AS type, amount AS amount, traded_at AS tradedAt, settle_block_id AS settleBlockId FROM cash_flow WHERE cash_flow_id = #{cashFlowId} AND company_id = #{companyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT sb.type AS type, sb.status AS status, sb.planned_amount AS plannedAmount FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id AND b.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id JOIN project p ON p.project_id = st.project_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE sb.settle_id = #{settleId} AND sb.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT sb.settle_id AS settleId, b.title AS roundName, p.name AS projectName, cf.linked_by AS linkedBy, e.name AS linkedByName, cf.linked_at AS linkedAt FROM cash_flow cf JOIN settlement_block sb ON sb.settle_id = cf.settle_block_id JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id JOIN project p ON p.project_id = st.project_id JOIN employee e ON e.user_id = cf.linked_by WHERE cf.cash_flow_id = #{cashFlowId} AND cf.company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT cash_flow_id AS cashFlowId, bank_txn_id AS bankTxnId, bank_name AS bankName, traded_at AS tradedAt, type AS type, amount AS amount, depositor_name AS depositorName, bank_memo AS memo, source_type AS sourceType, settle_block_id AS settleBlockId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM cash_flow WHERE cash_flow_id = #{cashFlowId} AND company_id = #{companyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT cash_flow_id AS cashFlowId, settle_block_id AS settleBlockId FROM cash_flow WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND cash_flow_id IN
#{id}
